text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mhm, mhm♪ I got such a great haul~! With 
this lucky charm——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
—Whoops, that was close! I forgot there's 
a mischievous kitty around here. I'd 
better put this away so it doesn't get 
snatched...

Not only did she fail to retrieve her 
charm, Machikane Fukukitaru was left 
completely exhausted...
